name: Visual Rendering
title_zh: 渲染前先问你要哪种光，再动手的绘图员
tagline_zh: 同一张场景图，能出晨昏、正午、阴天三种光感。不靠滤镜硬调，而是先算光源再画，适合对光影有执念的插画师。
tagline_en: Same scene, three light moods: dawn, noon, overcast. It computes light first, not filters later. For illustrators.
why_zh: 它把渲染拆成「定光源→选材质→算反射」三步，每一步都给你可改的参数，而不是一键出图的黑箱。
why_en: It splits rendering into light → material → reflection, each with tunable knobs. No black-box one-click output; you stay in.
limit_zh: 只支持静态场景的三种光照预设（晨昏/正午/阴天），不处理动画帧、透明材质或自定义光源方向。
limit_en: Only static scenes, 3 light presets. No animation/transparency/custom lights. Needs PBR maps; flat-color inputs error.
title_en: A renderer that asks which light you want before drawing
